functions.name: cancel_circle
functions.doc:
Cancels a circle that has not started: the organizer at any time, or
 anyone once the circle has stayed unfilled past its `fill_by`.

functions.name: claim_credit
functions.doc: Direct call: sends the caller money owed after a failed transfer.

functions.name: close_circle
functions.doc:
Anyone: deletes a finished or cancelled circle once all its money has
 gone back, freeing its storage. Members' records stay.

functions.name: create_circle
functions.doc:
Direct call: creates a circle organized by the caller, who doesn't take
 a seat. Attach 0.01 NEAR for the circle's storage. Returns its id.
 `order` is `join` (default) or `random`. `invite_key` (64 hex
 characters, ed25519) makes the circle invite-only.

functions.name: get_circles
functions.doc: Circles in id order. `from_index` defaults to 0, `limit` to 50 (at most 100).

functions.name: get_circles_for
functions.doc: Ids of the circles this account organizes or sits in.

type_schema.description:
NEAR Account Identifier.

This is a unique, syntactically valid, human-readable account identifier on the NEAR network.

[See the crate-level docs for information about validation.](index.html#account-id-rules)

Also see [Error kind precedence](AccountId#error-kind-precedence).

## Examples

``` use near_account_id::AccountId;

let alice: AccountId = "alice.near".parse().unwrap();

assert!("ƒelicia.near".parse::<AccountId>().is_err()); // (ƒ is not f) ```

functions.name: get_credit
functions.doc: Amount owed to this account after a failed transfer.

functions.name: get_round_deadline
functions.doc: Deadline of the running round in nanoseconds, or `null`.

functions.name: leave_circle
functions.doc: Direct call: leave a circle that has not started; the deposit comes back.

functions.name: list_seat
functions.doc: Direct call: lists the caller's seat for sale at `price`.

functions.name: mt_on_transfer
functions.doc:
NEP-245 receiver, called by NEAR Intents (a signed `Transfer` or an
 account's `mt_transfer_call`). `msg`: `create:...` (with the organizer's
 deposit), `join:<c>[:<invite sig>]`, `contribute:<c>:<round>`,
 `buy_seat:<c>:<seat>`, `refill:<c>`, `back:<c>`. Returns refunds; bad
 input is refunded in full.

 `list_seat:<c>:<seat>:<price>`, `unlist_seat:<c>:<seat>`, `cancel:<c>`,
 `claim_credit`.

functions.name: on_sent

functions.name: pay_out
functions.doc: Anyone: pays the pot when every member has paid, for example after a failed payout.

functions.name: release_deposits
functions.doc:
Anyone, after a circle finished or was cancelled: returns remaining
 deposits, as many as the attached gas allows. Returns how many were sent.

functions.name: settle_round
functions.doc:
Anyone, after the round deadline: missed contributions come out of
 deposits, then the pot is paid out.

functions.name: unlist_seat
functions.doc: Direct call: takes the caller's seat off sale.

Backer.description: Money a community put behind a circle. It covers missed payments a deposit can't; what is left is split back in proportion when the circle ends.

due.description: Share of the leftover backing not yet sent back.

contribution.description: Amount each member pays per round, in the token's smallest unit.

fill_by.description: Nanoseconds. After this, anyone can cancel the circle if it is still open.

invite_only.description: Joining needs a signed invite from the circle's invite link.

listings.description: Asking price per seat, or `null` when the seat is not for sale.

members.description: Index = seat = turn. Seat `n` receives the pot in round `n`.

name.description: Encrypted by the app with a key from the invite link. The contract stores it as given.
